description: Garfield++ Examples/Gem reproduced in SimGEM: single standard GEM, Ar:CO2 80:20, 1 atm, dV = 300 V, for validation against the example's ANSYS field map
notes: Geometry and potentials from Examples/Gem/Ansys/gem: pitch 140 um (hex), kapton 50 um (eps 4.0), metal 5 um, holes 70/50 um, rim 80 um; drift plane 1.0 mm and induction plane 1.0 mm from the kapton centre.
Example potentials: drift -200 V, top metal -150 V, bottom metal +150 V, induction +350 V; SimGEM puts the induction plane at 0 V (all shifted by -350 V, same fields).
Gas as in gem.C: Ar:CO2 80:20, 760 Torr, 293.15 K, Penning r = 0.51 on Ar.
